name: RadBio Ch4 Protein Mnemonics
description: A single self-contained, shareable HTML page presenting the Chapter 4 protein-name decoding table and the mnemonic devices I wrote for the user (DEAB cyclin order, 4-6-2-2-1 CDK partners, five CDK switches, SQ1 chain story and S-S-S-E-A, G2/M checkpoint, checkpoint-protein hooks, apoptosis route, CKIs, SNoW DRoP blots, gene-delivery words, silencing, vectors) plus the short "how to make these stick" study tips. Content is exactly the material in known_data; the page should read well on an iPad and print to roughly one or two pages.
